target_customer: Indian MSMEs that issue invoices and need to collect payments and reconcile them
problem: Reconciliation of bank statements against invoices is manual and error prone for Indian small businesses. yBANQ built collections, reconciliation and bookkeeping tooling, pitched as a Bill.com for India.
business_model: B2B SaaS and payments for collections and reconciliation

founders.name: Abhishek Ayyagari
founders.background_notes: YC bio: former head of product at PayU, former CPO at Citrus Payments, built PayPal's Subscriptions business.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching bank statements to invoices, Tally sync and settlements are standard fintech engineering with integration work, per product descriptions in YourStory.

defensibility.rationale: Accounting integrations create some stickiness but the product was a thin layer for a 9 person team with banks and accounting vendors adjacent.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Clear (ClearTax) bought the company in July 2021 in a cash and equity deal with undisclosed terms, to build B2B payments and collections.

market_need_then: YC description states reconciliation is largely manual and error prone for Indian MSMEs. No dated spend figure was opened.

brand_strength.rationale: No source shows press, community or founder commentary about the brand itself, so no brand strength can be shown.

outcome_analysis: yBANQ joined YC in Winter 2020 led by a former PayU product head and sold to Clear in July 2021 in a cash and equity deal, about a year and a half after founding. Terms were undisclosed and the stage of funding is unclear, so the exit reads as a strategic acquisition into an established tax and fintech platform rather than a venture scale outcome.
